qualification.details: Applicants must have successfully completed Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act from the FACT Training & Development Centre on or before 31.12.2025, in the category specified below. Two notes in the notification apply: | Apprentices who have completed or are completing Apprenticeship in the year 2026 need not apply. They will be considered for engagement against requirements, if any, from the list sourced directly from the FACT Training & Development Centre. Only candidates who upload both the Certificate of Proficiency (COP) and the Certificate issued by FACT Training & Development Centre along with the online form will be considered for inclusion in the Panel. | Meeting the eligibility criteria or inclusion in the Panel does not by itself give any right to selection or engagement. | The age limit as on 01.10.2026 is less than 35 years and above 18 years. salary_details.details: Candidates offered engagement will be paid a consolidated pay of Rs. 31,000/- per month. An increase of 3% of the consolidated pay will be paid on successful completion of each year. Leave, ESI, Provident Fund, and TA & DA for duty travel apply based on eligibility, as per Company rules. | The engagement is for one year, renewable for a maximum of 3 spells of one year each, at the Management's discretion, subject to requirement, performance and assessment. The Management may terminate the engagement with 15 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason. The engagement does not confer any right to extension, permanent appointment or preferential treatment. Panel candidates may also be considered for shorter-duration engagement at rates and terms fixed by the Company.

selection_process: The notification does not mention a written test or interview. After preliminary scrutiny of the documents submitted with the application
candidates are ranked in the following order:
Earlier date of passing Apprenticeship Training. Order of Apprenticeship Token Number.

Eligibility and selection are decided on the information and documents submitted. Candidature is provisional at all stages. Provisionally selected candidates must undergo a pre-employment medical examination and be certified fit by the Company's Medical Officer
meeting the Company's physical/medical standards (available on the Company website). No relaxation is allowed

and the Medical Officer's opinion is final. Engagement is subject to continued medical fitness during the contract and submission of a Police Clearance Certificate. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process.

EWS and PWBD candidates applies as per Government Directives. EWS candidates must submit the EWS certificate of the relevant year (income of FY 2025-26 for engagement during FY 2026-27). OBC-NCL candidates must submit a self-declaration in the prescribed format on the website
along with the OBC-NCL certificate. If engaged

they must produce an OBC-NCL certificate from the Competent Authority issued within 6 months before joining. PWBD candidates must submit the certificate from the Authority as prescribed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017.
how_to_apply: Candidates apply in two stages: submit the Online Form, then send the hard copy.
Visit www.fact.co.in and go to Careers > Job Openings > Recruitment Notification 7/2026. Click the Online Application link.
Fill in all necessary data. The data in the Online Form and the uploaded Application Form must be the same.
Upload the mandatory documents in PDF format (listed below) in the prescribed place.
Click the Submit button.
Application Form in the prescribed format (the "Application Form" on the website along with the notification), manually filled, signed and photo affixed.
Standard X Certificate.
Degree (B.Tech/BE) pass certificate.
Certificate of Proficiency (COP) as in the specification.
Apprenticeship Training Certificate issued by FACT T&D Centre.
Caste / EWS / Disability Certificate, if reservation or relaxation is claimed.
Self-declaration by OBC-NCL candidates.
Online Forms submitted without these essential documents, or with an Application Form that is not duly filled, are liable to be rejected.

Send the original Application Form and self-attested copies of all relevant certificates/documents proving eligibility and experience, along with the original certificates, by Speed Post / Registered Post to:
The envelope must be superscribed "Application for the post of Engineer (IT) on FTCAB - Adv. 7/2026".
Only applications submitted online with the prescribed Application Form and certificates are considered. Applications by any other mode are rejected.
A submitted application is final and no changes are entertained.

Further notifications are published on www.fact.co.in > Careers. Individual communication, if any, is only through the e-mail id used for the Online Form, which must stay valid and functional. FACT is not responsible for failed communication through that e-mail id.

Applications and documents of applicants not included in the Panel are not retained for more than one year from the date of publication of the Panel. All documents related to this selection are preserved only for two years from that date.
Any dispute regarding this recruitment is settled only in courts within the jurisdiction of Ernakulam, Kerala State.

content_sections.heading: FACT Engineer IT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have successfully completed Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act from the FACT Training & Development Centre on or before 31.12.2025, in the category specified below. Two notes in the notification apply: Apprentices who have completed or are completing Apprenticeship in the year 2026 need not apply. They will be considered for engagement against requirements, if any, from the list sourced directly from the FACT Training & Development Centre. Only candidates who upload both the Certificate of Proficiency (COP) and the Certificate issued by FACT Training & Development Centre along with the online form will be considered for inclusion in the Panel. Meeting the eligibility criteria or inclusion in the Panel does not by itself give any right to selection or engagement. The age limit as on 01.10.2026 is less than 35 years and above 18 years. Later engagements from the Panel are subject to meeting the maximum age limit on the date of engagement. The Std X certificate with date of birth is the only document accepted as proof of date of birth.

The engagement is for one year, renewable for a maximum of 3 spells of one year each, at the Management's discretion, subject to requirement, performance and assessment. The Management may terminate the engagement with 15 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason. The engagement does not confer any right to extension, permanent appointment or preferential treatment. Panel candidates may also be considered for shorter-duration engagement at rates and terms fixed by the Company.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification is released by Fertilisers And Chemicals Travancore (FACT) for filling positions on a fixed tenure contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under Advt No 7/2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Engineer (IT) on Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc Basis) under the Information Technology field in FACT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the final submission of the online application form is 14-10-2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Engineer (IT)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Apprenticeship in Degree (B.Tech/BE) in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology from FACT Training & Development Centre.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PWBD.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 31,000/- per month with an annual increase as per the company's guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for FACT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this specific recruitment drive by Fertilisers And Chemicals Travancore.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes preliminary scrutiny of documents and ranking based on the earlier date of passing Apprenticeship Training and Apprenticeship Token Number.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application form?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must send the original printed application form along with all relevant documents by Speed Post or Registered Post to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of Fertilisers And Chemicals Travancore at www.fact.co.in under the Careers and Job Openings section to apply online.
